The '''76th Regiment''' was an [[Tank (disambiguation)|armored]] [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]]<ref name="76th ATTE" /> of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]<ref name="76th ATRT" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

Led by a [[clone regimental commander]] and a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]],<ref name="Regiment leadership" /> the 76th Regiment was a part of a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]], and consisted of 2,304 [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] subdivided into four [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]], along with support personnel.<ref name="Regiment" /> The 76th Regiment utilized several ground vehicles that had [[Color/Legends|olive green]] markings, including
[[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|All Terrain Attack Pods]],<ref name="76th ATAP" /> [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]],<ref name="76th ATRT" /> [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]],<ref name="76th ATTE" /> and [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernauts]].<ref name="76th Juggernaut" /> Troopers in the unit wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with olive green markings as well.<ref name="76th ATRT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 76th Regiment was first mentioned in the ''[[Ground Assault]]'' installment of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' trading card game,<ref name="76th ATTE" /> published by [[WizKids Games]] in [[2007]].<ref name="Ground Assault">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/misc/news20070426.html|text=Closer Look: ''Star Wars'' PocketModel Trading Card Game}}</ref>
